commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Guglielmo Vicario makes a comfortable save.
90+5' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+3' A cross from Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+2' Michael Carrick has decided to make a change. Tyler Fletcher (Manchester United) replaces Kobbie Mainoo.
90+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
90+1' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
87' Substitution. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) in, Bryan Mbeumo out.
87' That's the end of the game for Casemiro, who is replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
87' Michael Carrick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) replacing Luke Shaw.
86' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
81' 2 - 0 Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches onto a cross in the penalty area and fires the ball into the bottom right corner!
80' It will be a substitution. Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Conor Gallagher walks off.
80' Here is a change. Joao Palhinha is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Mathys Tel (Tottenham).
80' Substitution. Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) has come on for Dominic Solanke.

79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
78' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

77' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
77' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Tottenham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matheus Cunha as he is replaced by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United).
75' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). Tottenham are awarded the free kick.
74' Casemiro (Manchester United) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to intercept.
72' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

71' Half-chance! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) plays a pass into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
69' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
68' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
67' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
65' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
65' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game.
64' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a chip pass into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario is quickest to intercept the ball.
62' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Luke Shaw (Manchester United), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
62' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Manchester Utd have a free kick.

61' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
61' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

60' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Guglielmo Vicario is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
58' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United).

57' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
56' That's unlucky! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
55' Destiny Udogie is substituted due to injury. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Souza (Tottenham).
54' Looks like Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

51' The ball is laid off to Casemiro (Manchester United) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Guglielmo Vicario to make a decent save.
50' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
49' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Michael Oliver blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
45+2' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) meets a cross inside the box, but Guglielmo Vicario wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
44' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Casemiro (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
44' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
44' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Manchester Utd get a corner.
43' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

41' Casemiro (Manchester United) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a stunning save! Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

40' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester Utd.
38' 1 - 0 What a hit! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.

37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
36' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
33' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
32' Thomas Frank is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Wilson Odobert will be replaced by Radu Dragusin (Tottenham).
29' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
27' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
25' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
23' Amad Diallo plays a lovely pass into Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
22' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
22' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is caught offside!

21' What an opportunity! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
19' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

16' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
15' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
14' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
14' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
14' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
12' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot low towards the middle of the net that is easily dealt with by Senne Lammens.

11' A long pass finds Casemiro (Manchester United), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the left side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well to make a good save.
10' Casemiro (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
10' Manchester Utd try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
10' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
8' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) brings his opponent down. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.

4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Oliver stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Tottenham have a free kick.
3' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but Guglielmo Vicario comfortably gathers the ball.
2' What a huge chance for Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
